parsed.answer: I received a navigation goal; the controller reported failed progress and aborted, and the navigation skill reported a timeout. Within the observed acceptance-to-terminal window, sampled odometry estimated about 0.000009 m of XY travel; recorded navigation commands were nonzero, while recorded controller output commands were zero. Charging was indicated, and the configured charging lock outranks navigation, but the cause of failure and actual physical motion remain unknown.
